# YouTube:
- Change target version back to `v19.02.xx`
- fix(Default Video Quality): Video quality is not changeable if default ones is already set
- fix(Hide interstitial ads): Crashing when trying to hide
- feat(Ambient mode switch): Apply fingerprint compatible with the wider version
- feat(Shorts): Add `Hide double tap to like animations` patch
- refactor: Replace `NewPipe x SponsorBlock` with `Tubular`

# YouTube Music:
- feat(Hide new playlist button): Apply fingerprint compatible with the wider version

Thank you for using so far !!!
